summary: Lets an AI agent file requests to a human lawyer for legal review, confirmation, signatures or physical-world tasks.
whenToUse: Use only when the user explicitly wants an outside human to review, confirm or perform something for their task.
flags: tool descriptions encourage agents to escalate past or report on their operator to a third party (operator_escalation)
asks agent to disclose operator, principal identity, model and task context to a permanent external record
